title: centrapalus subaphyllus
intro: Centrapalus subaphyllus, commonly known as 'bush calocephalus' or 'bush woollyheads', is a small shrub native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of Centrapalus subaphyllus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
